notes.title: Another Gamescom, another demo update 🐷💀🖤
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that Spindle will be playable again at Gamescom this year! 
From August 20 to 24, visit Kim & Tom in Hall 10.2 at the Deck13 Spotlight Indie Arena Booth 🎉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40899870/8a7d1d7ae161d3255354c1fedac7e73823124ac9.png
Some familiar sights, but so much more to explore
To celebrate this occasion, we're adding a bunch of new content to previous versions of the demo. This update really highlights how far we've come in terms of the level of detail and the attention we've put into every little interaction in our world.

Experience the beginning of the game, including the never-before-seen intro, and explore how the first area of Spindle changes after defeating the dungeon boss. This gives you a much better idea of what the final game will feel like, with lots of fun details to discover 🐣

Let us know what you think
If you're also attending Gamescom, be sure to stop by and chat! Otherwise, feel free to join our Discord server and tell us your thoughts on the update there! 

The finish line draws near, so please enjoy the demo and stay tuned for more information soon (especially regarding the exact release date 👀)! 
And as always, thank you for your ongoing support, we were so happy to see how excited people were about last week's trailer 💌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386750/Spindle/

notes.title: We're getting closer: Our Release Window Trailer ⏰
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Great news: we're almost at the finish line, and we can now give you a better hint on when you can expect to start adventuring with Death and Pig 💀🖤🐷



And now, drumroll please... 
Spindle will release in ***ber 2025 🎉
We know, we know - it's not quite a specific date yet. However, it won't be too long until we can tell you more!

In the meantime, check out our new Release Window Trailer to discover some new areas, enemies, and obstacles that you'll need to overcome in Spindle. We've come a long way since we began development, and we're extremely proud of our progress.



Also: stay tuned! Another update is coming next week, and it may be related to Gamescom and our Demo... 👀

notes.title: Spindle @ Gamescom 2023 & Demo Update
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce: Spindle is part of Gamescom 2023!

To show you what we've been working on, we're bringing you an updated demo of our game. If you're attending the convention, you can find us at the Indie Arena Booth in Hall 10.2. We're looking forward to meeting you, so stop by and say hello! 
Of course, the new demo will not only be available at Gamescom, but also here on Steam. Head over to the Steam page to check it out!

notes.title: Spindle Developer Stream & Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
